task.title: Connecting to the NC State VPN Hub

taskbody.p: NC State provides a virtual private network (VPN) connection through the Cisco Secure Client software. A VPN connection is typically required when an individual may access sensitive information or on-campus resources from an off-campus connection. To download and install Cisco Secure Client to your computer, please select your operating system or device below.

steps.step: Download the Cisco Secure Client 5.X installer.
Double click on the downloaded file to begin the installation.
Accept the End User License Agreement.
Click on the Install button.
If you are prompted, allow the application to make changes on your computer.
Download the Secure Client 5.X installer for macOS
Double-click to open the NCSU-Campus-Cisco_Secure_AnyConnect-5.1.1.42.pkg file.
Double-click the Cisco Secure Client.pkg icon.
Click the Continue button on the Introduction and License Agreement screens.
Click Agree to the terms of the software license agreement.
In the Destination Select window, choose the disk where you want to install the software if prompted, and click Continue.
In the Installation Type window, UNCHECK EVERYTHING except AnyConnect VPN, click Continue and click Install.

section.title: Linux
section.p: Most users running Linux have better success connecting with the NC State VPN utilizing the OpenConnect client instead of the client packages provided by Cisco. Below are the instructions last tested for Ubuntu 22.04 running Gnome. You will need to adjust the package manager commands or appropriate GUI for your Linux distro and preferences. OIT does not provide advanced troubleshooting for Linux and every Linux distro out there.
section.subtitle: Install OpenConnect Client

steps.step: Open a Terminal window.
Enter this command: sudo apt-get -y install openconnect network-manager-openconnect network-manager-openconnect-gnome
Enter your administrator password when prompted.
Wait for the packages to finish installing.

section.subtitle: Set Up the NC State VPN Connection

steps.step: Select the Network icon in the upper-right.
Open the Network Settings.
Select the + icon next to the VPN Heading.
Select Multi-Protocol VPN Client, and change the following settings. All other settings can be left as provided.

substeps.substep: Name: NC State VPN (or any other meaningful name)
VPN Protocol: Cisco AnyConnect or openconnect

steps.step: Select Add in the top right.

section.subtitle: Connect to the NC State VPN

steps.step: From the Network Icon in the upper-right, select VPN OFF.
Select Connect.
Choose the appropriate VPN Group.
Enter your Unity ID as the username.
Enter your Unity ID password in the first Password field.
In the Second Password field, use one of the methods below to sign in with Duo.

substeps.substep: push to receive a Duo Push. Be sure to check the Duo Mobile app for the push. Note: This is the default when this field is left empty.
A code from the Duo Mobile app.
Get a Duo code when you only have a Security Key/U2F Token.

ul.title: ChromeOS
ul.subtitle: Download Cisco AnyConnect

steps.step: Open the Chrome Browser.
Navigate to the Chrome Store.
In the left sidebar menu, type AnyConnect in the search field.
Select the Apps radio button and see the Cisco AnyConnect VPN Client listed.
Click [+Add to Chrome].

ul.subtitle: Configure the VPN

steps.step: Click on the App Launcher button to view installed Applications.
Click on the AnyConnect icon to start the configuration process.
In the AnyConnect window, select [+Add New Connection].
In the Name field, enter NCSU VPN.
In the Server Address field, enter vpn.ncsu.edu.
Click [Save Changes] and exit the application window.

ul.subtitle: Connect to the NCSU VPN using AnyConnect

steps.step: Click on the Status Menu at the bottom right corner of your screen.
Click on the key icon [Show VPN Settings] -it will be set to Off.
Click [NCSU VPN (user)].
From the Group drop-down, select GROUP 2-Student (or 1-Faculty-and-Staff).

substeps.substep: Note that the Mobility Print printers are not available in full tunnel (FT) VPN.
Enter your UNITY ID and password.
In the Second Password field, type push, SMS, or passcode to authenticate.
